blocks.html:
The Dies academicus is the annual celebration of the University, a significant moment to share and learn about USI and its developments.

The Dies includes an official address by the Rector and speeches by guest speakers, both from within and beyond USI. It is also an opportunity to welcome at USI the Rectors from other universities, to assign the Award for Best Teaching - which rewards the best teacher of one of the USI Faculties (in turns) -, and to award the accolades: Honorary Doctorate, title of Honorary Member of the University, and Medal of the University.

The next Dies academicus (the 31st) will be held on: 24 April 2027.
